title: The Hajnal-Szemerédi theorem in digraphs revisited
summary: The Hajnal--Szemerédi theorem states that every graph with $Δ(G)\le k-1$ admits an equitable $k$-coloring. Using a reduction implicit in Aboulker, Oijid, Petit, Rocton, and Simon (which itself builds on the literature surrounding feedback arc sets), we prove that this theorem is equivalent to each of four digraph analogues guaranteeing equitable acyclic $k$-colorings under various degree conditions.
